cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
mkdir -p backup_log; cp classic_acct.py classic_pos_html.py runs.json backup_log/
for f in classic_acct.py classic_pos_html.py; do
  curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f" -o /tmp/new_$f || { echo FETCH_FAIL $f; exit 1; }
  python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('/tmp/new_$f',encoding='utf-8').read())" || { echo PARSE_FAIL $f; exit 1; }
done
for f in classic_acct.py classic_pos_html.py; do cp /tmp/new_$f $f; done; chown tbot:tbot classic_*.py
systemctl restart classicbot
T0=$(date +%s)
for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 3; L=$(curl -s -m 10 localhost:8091/api/runs | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('1' if d.get('loading') else '0')" 2>/dev/null); [ "$L" = "0" ] && break; done
echo готово_через=$(( $(date +%s)-T0 ))с
cmp runs.json backup_log/runs.json && echo runs_unchanged
curl -s localhost:8091/api/runs | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
for k in ('me','bot','both'):
    a=d['accounts'][k]['account']; print(k,'эквити',a['equity'],'взято',a['taken'],'закрыто',a['closed'],'прибыльных',a['wins'],a['win_pct'],'в журнале',len(a['log']))"
curl -s localhost:8091/ | grep -c "max-height:340px"
journalctl -u classicbot --since '2 min ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -c Traceback
